# CLI reference

Every `gg` flag, generated from the argument parser.

## Help output

```text
A small Rust agentic harness

Usage: gg [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]

Arguments:
  [PROMPT]  Positional prompt, the `--mode json` spelling: gg --mode json "…"

Options:
  -p, --print <PROMPT>
          One-shot print mode: run this prompt and print the final answer. A prompt of "-" reads the prompt text from stdin
      --tools <TOOLS>
          Comma-separated tool allowlist, e.g. "read,bash". Overrides the `tools` setting from config files. A nested run can only name tools its parent run has
  -c, --continue
          Continue the newest session for this directory
      --resume <RESUME>
          Resume a session by id (or a unique id prefix)
      --no-session
          Do not persist a session for this run
      --mode <MODE>
          Output mode for one-shot runs: `print` (default: final text to stdout) or `json` (session header, then one AgentEvent per line) [default: print] [possible values: print, json]
      --export <SESSION [OUT_HTML]>...
          Export a session to a single self-contained HTML file and exit. SESSION is a file path or the id/8-hex prefix `--resume` takes; OUT_HTML defaults to `<session-stem>.html` in the cwd
      --watch
          Development mode: watch the ganggang sources, rebuild on change, and re-exec the new binary on the same session
  -P, --provider <PROVIDER>
          Provider preset or configured provider name (e.g. "strata", "glm-coding-plan", "opencode-go", "deepseek")
  -m, --model <MODEL>
          Model id or `provider/model` (overrides config and provider default)
      --list-models
          List configured providers and models (probing local servers), then exit
      --no-hooks
          Skip user hooks for this run, including the hooks file and the project-file warning. Ignored in a nested run, which keeps its parent's hooks
      --reasoning-effort <EFFORT>
          Reasoning effort sent to supporting endpoints (e.g. "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "none"). Pass "" to clear a provider preset's default
      --thinking-budget <TOKENS>
          Cap thinking/reasoning tokens per turn (Strata/local backends). 0 disables any preset cap
      --max-turns <N>
          Maximum turns per run (0 disables). Soft wrap-up nudge at 80% of budget. A nested run cannot exceed its parent's
      --session-file <PATH>
          Persist and/or resume this exact session JSONL file path
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version
```
